keys: keys/*.pub.pem verify these examples. keys/*.TEST-ONLY.pem are their private halves, published on purpose so the signatures can be reproduced: they protect nothing and must never be configured on a server.

examples.name: capabilities
examples.description: ClientSt0r → rem0te: discovery. `organizations` is the explicit binding (contract revision 2): one organization per business, each request names its organization, and `paused` lists the containment kinds in force.

examples.name: error.clientst0r-hmac-request
examples.description: ClientSt0r → rem0te, signed the way ClientSt0r signs today (HMAC-SHA256, X-Integration-* headers). Refused: ticket-rmm-v1 is Ed25519 with rem0te-* headers. See CLIENTST0R.md.

examples.name: job-submit
examples.description: ClientSt0r → rem0te: analyse one ticket, with rem0te's evidence about the bound computer. Signed request plus a delegation token bound to the body hash (req_sha256).

examples.name: inference
examples.description: rem0te → ClientSt0r: one model run for a job. ClientSt0r holds the provider key and calls the model; rem0te never does. The response is signed over the request nonce and the body hash.

examples.name: job-result
examples.description: ClientSt0r → rem0te: poll the job. `result` is staff-facing analysis; every next step is `executable: false`.

examples.name: event.job-succeeded
examples.description: rem0te → ClientSt0r: a signed job event, pushed to the events URL. Verify `signature` over "rem0te-event-v1\n" + canonical JSON of `event`.

examples.name: error.paused-business
examples.description: ClientSt0r → rem0te: a job for a business under a containment pause. 423 CONTAINED; nothing is queued.

examples.name: action-proposal
examples.description: ClientSt0r → rem0te: propose a catalog action from an AI suggestion on a ticket. It becomes a plan awaiting independent approval on rem0te's approval signer; nothing runs until approvers sign it there.

examples.name: alert-event.raised-with-patch-summary
examples.description: rem0te → ClientSt0r: a signed alert event for a REBOOT_PENDING alert, carrying the redacted patch summary (revision 2). Verify over "rem0te-alert-event-v1\n" + canonical JSON of `alert_event`.

examples.name: alert-ticket-link
examples.description: ClientSt0r → rem0te: link the ticket it opened. Idempotent for the same ticket; another ticket is 409.

examples.name: job-submit.replayed
examples.description: ClientSt0r → rem0te: the same idempotency key and body again (here after a restart). 200 with idempotent-replayed: true and the same job — never a second job.
